categories.main_business_segments: Gongniu Group operates primarily in three business segments: electrical connection products (including converters, digital accessories, and power tools), intelligent electrical lighting products (including wall switches, LED lighting, smart home electrical appliances such as smart locks and dryers), and new energy products (including new energy vehicle charging piles/guns, home and commercial energy storage). These segments collectively form a comprehensive industrial layout in the civil electrical and lighting fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes innovation in product design, technology, and manufacturing processes, including automation, digitalization, and lean production. It has developed proprietary technologies in power distribution units, charging control units, and charging modules for new energy products. Manufacturing is vertically integrated from raw materials like copper and plastics to finished goods, with advanced automation such as AGV logistics, AI machine vision for quality control, and smart factory systems (MES, APS).
categories.primary_customers_markets: Gongniu serves a broad customer base including residential consumers, commercial and industrial clients, and strategic operators in the new energy sector. Key markets include home electrical users, construction and engineering projects, digital accessory consumers, and new energy vehicle owners and operators. The company also targets B2B customers such as large operators and government projects, especially in emerging and developed international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with a nationwide sales network covering over 1.1 million retail outlets. Internationally, Gongniu has expanded into Southeast Asia, Europe (notably Germany and Italy), and emerging markets including the Middle East and Latin America. It maintains localized operations and sales teams in key overseas markets to support product adaptation and customer service.
categories.supply_chain_position: Gongniu occupies a vertically integrated position in the supply chain, controlling upstream raw material processing, midstream manufacturing, and downstream distribution. It produces key components in-house, including molds, electronic parts, and battery packs, and manages an end-to-end smart supply chain ecosystem that enhances quality, cost control, and delivery efficiency.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities focus on intelligent ecosystems, new energy innovation, and internationalization. R&D efforts emphasize smart home electrical solutions integrating AI and IoT, advanced charging and energy storage technologies, and health-focused lighting products. Gongniu invests heavily in product innovation, digital transformation, and building localized R&D and marketing capabilities globally.
categories.revenue_model: Gongniu generates revenue primarily through product sales across its three main segments. Sales channels include offline retail via extensive dealer networks, direct sales to commercial and industrial clients, and online e-commerce platforms. The company also derives income from licensing and service contracts related to its smart and new energy products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Gongniu is a leading domestic brand in the civil electrical industry, recognized for product quality, innovation, and brand reputation. It holds top market positions in converters, wall switches, and new energy vehicle charging products on major e-commerce platforms. The company competes with both domestic and international electrical and smart home brands, leveraging its integrated supply chain and broad sales network as competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Gongniu achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 16.83 billion, a 7.24% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 4.27 billion, up 10.39%. The company maintains steady growth with expanding revenues in all segments, especially rapid growth in new energy products (over 100% increase). It has a strong asset base exceeding RMB 20 billion and continues to invest in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Gongniu emphasizes product quality, safety, and innovation as its core value proposition, branding itself as a 'safe electricity expert.' It differentiates through high-end, stylish, and technologically advanced products tailored to consumer needs, including smart home ecosystems and new energy solutions. The company’s vertically integrated supply chain and comprehensive service capabilities ensure reliable delivery and customer satisfaction, reinforcing its premium brand image.
